RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are women, so sex is exceedingly unlikely to have influenced the hiring decision. An all-female panel choosing between female candidates provides no indication of gender bias. For a laboratory head position, healthcare institutions frequently prioritize formal management qualifications and broad leadership experience over advanced research degrees like a PhD.

Raising the panel's gender composition lacks factual or legal merit, would appear unfounded, and risks harming your professional reputation within the hospital. Instead, send a polite follow-up regarding your requested feedback, framing it constructively around leadership competencies and areas you can develop for future senior roles.
